reserveReview.rationale: Frax documents sfrxUSD as an ERC-4626-like token redeemable for frxUSD and describes its Benchmark Yield Strategy across carry-trade, DeFi AMO, and Treasury venues. At Ethereum block 26285088 (hash 0xcc8cd23cedcdd85f2bd114cc1057297acbdbdb7776785585465fec8904420534, finalized, 2026-10-27T15:57:11Z), vault 0xcf62f905562626cfcdd2261162a51fd02fc9c5b6 (proxy implementation 0xaad4a1d92053a62ce7a787641d8b4e5883e96700) returned name Staked Frax USD, symbol sfrxUSD, and asset() 0xcacd6fd266af91b8aed52accc382b4e165586e29 (Frax USD). totalAssets() was 41,537,037.462271895111296072 frxUSD and the underlying balanceOf(vault) was zero. With no idle underlying held, the reviewed deployedExposure attestation on the live adapter config attributes the vault's full deployed share to this reviewed slice, so the producer publishes one reviewed row keyed by the frxUSD underlying address rather than a vault-addressed deployed remainder; the protocol-position classification and frxUSD wrapper dependency are retained, and this review does not establish current strategy allocations or a maximum maturity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Frax strategy documentation and aggregate vault accounting pinned at Ethereum block 26285088 (2026-10-27T15:57:11Z); no venue-level composition refresh
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The historical aggregate review identifies the Benchmark Yield Strategy failure domain and frxUSD redemption denomination, not a complete current single-parent portfolio. The issuer now publishes a venue-level balance-sheet export, including frxUSD lending, reUSD, crvUSD and USDT positions; the previous blanket statement that allocations are unpublished was incorrect. That export has not been reconciled here to the complete economic liability/encumbrance census and establishes neither whole-book legal custody protection nor a maximum liquidation horizon.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Frax's current sfrxUSD documentation permits allocation of staked frxUSD to DeFi lending venues; FIP-434 explicitly includes borrowing reUSD against lending positions and stablecoins against collateral. Capital reuse is therefore permitted, not absent. This does not measure current use, allocation, or leverage. Current venue-level legal segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness remain unverified; frxUSD issuer terms cannot be inherited as wrapper-local safeguards.
